vision.label: Business goal
vision.title: What we build
vision.intro: AInsekt Farm is a long-term infrastructure venture in the renewable energy and circular bioeconomy sectors. We are not chasing quick returns — we are building an asset that generates stable, regulated revenue for 15 years and creates real value for local agriculture.
vision.goalDesc: Build and commission a standalone 400 kW biogas CHP plant by September 2029 — generating 2,452 MWh per year of controllable 24/7 baseload, independent of weather.
vision.missionDesc: Close the loop of organic waste in Polish agriculture. Every ton of substrate from a local farm — potatoes, silage, apples — becomes energy, heat and organic fertilizer that returns to the same fields.
vision.visionDesc: A network of sister SPVs across Poland — each biogas plant a standalone, self-financing unit. Poland as the reference market for scaling the model across Central Europe through 2030 and beyond.

streams.label: Six platform pillars
streams.title: Phase I stands alone.
streams.desc: Biogas plant as a standalone unit, financed by the FEnIKS grant. Phases II (BSF) and III (AI Compute) financed from Phase I cash flow and additional grants — not preconditions for Phase I returns.
streams.flikDesc: CSTR high-efficiency cogeneration · 400 kWel + 460 kWth · 2,452 MWh/year · FIT 974 PLN/MWh for 15 years
streams.bsfDesc: €2.38M for €2.8M project · NFOŚiGW Part 5 · 2027 cycle target · HEC qualification verified
streams.btcDesc: 5,500 t/year · 4 logistics zones 0–120 km · +11pp margin above URE 80% threshold for 'agricultural biogas' category
streams.aiDesc: Operational waste marketplace · biogas plant ↔ supplier matchmaking · automatic substrate routing (ainsektfarm.com)
streams.biogasDesc: 1,200 m² Black Soldier Fly farm · 53t meal + 22t oil + 900t frass/year · CHP heat reuse · launch ~2031
streams.heatDesc: 16 NVIDIA H100/H200 GPUs powered by biogas · green compute premium 20–40% · GPU heat → BSF · launch ~2032

energy.label: Energy architecture · Phase I
energy.title: 400 kW in HEC.
energy.desc: CSTR reactor with mesophilic fermentation 38–42°C · 1,500 m³ main fermenter + 1,200 m³ post-fermenter · 35-day HRT · 2,452 MWh/year of controllable 24/7 baseload, weather-independent.
energy.btcDesc: 2,452 MWh/year net · FIT 95% × 1,025 PLN/MWh = €565K/year · 15-year fixed contract · regulatory guarantee through 2044.
energy.aiDesc: ~460 kWth · 15% maintains fermenter temperature · 85% available for local off-take or Phase II BSF · upside potential +€30–50K/year.
energy.heatDesc: ~4,800 t/year · conservative €25/t = €60K/year · sold to local farmers · 2,500 m³ tank (mandatory 6-month storage).

flik.label: FLIK App · LIVE
flik.title: Circular-economy waste
flik.desc: FLIK is an operational app (ainsektfarm.com) connecting biogas plants, supermarkets, farmers and businesses. The direct channel for sourcing agricultural substrate for Phase I.
flik.subdesc: Live map · price countdown · reservation system · substrate-delivery routing · CSRD ESG reports · FEnIKS audit-trail integration
flik.biogasDesc: Capacity registration · real-time waste matching · framework supply agreements · LOIs for grant applications
flik.supermarketsDesc: Expiry countdown · waste collection · gate fee €30–35/t · Zero Waste certificate for ESG reports
flik.farmersDesc: Substrate collection (potatoes, silage, apples) · digestate orders as fertilizer · validation LOIs
flik.individualsDesc: Buy discounted food · report waste · earn Green Points → loyalty tokens (post-launch)
flik.businessesDesc: Organic waste pickup planning · bulk purchases · on-chain CSRD ESG reports · compliance audit trail
flik.mapDesc: Real-time pins for near-expiry products, waste pickups, biogas capacity and farmer stands. Refreshed every 5 minutes.
flik.countdownDesc: Automatic markdowns: 48h=20% · 24h=40% · 12h=60% · 6h=80% · Unsold → automatically routed to biogas.
flik.gpDesc: Automatic match of waste streams to the nearest biogas plant · 4 logistics zones · per-ton cost optimization.
flik.reservDesc: Reserve products 1–48h ahead. Generate preliminary LOIs for grant projects with audit trail for FEnIKS.
flik.nftDesc: Monthly certificate for companies. Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum. CSRD-compliant. Marketing badge + ESG proof.
flik.agentDesc: Recipes for near-expiry food · CO₂ impact calculator · auto-generated ESG reports · routing waste to optimal destination.

token.label: Financing stack
token.title: 10 Polish + 8 EU
token.desc: Strategy: one main CAPEX grant (FEnIKS Part 5) + WFOŚiGW preferential loan for equity contribution + supplements from FENG/KPO + parallel EIC Accelerator application. No institutional capital required for Phase I.
token.gpRewardsDesc: Main CAPEX grant · up to 85% of eligible costs · €2.38M for our project · 2027 cycle target · HEC qualification verified (<70% heat to district heating).
token.stakingDesc: 1–3% interest per year · up to 15-year repayment · covers equity contribution after the FEnIKS grant · partial write-off 10–20% possible upon meeting environmental goals.
token.btcDesc: Alternative call in case FEnIKS is rejected · up to 100% of net costs · mix of grant + 0% loan + market-rate loan · no HEC requirement.
token.daoDesc: Strongest instrument for deep-tech · grant up to €2.5M + €15M equity · 2026 cycles: March/July/October · 3-min video pitch · circular bioeconomy category.
token.computeDesc: Component covering proprietary AI for fermentation monitoring + FLIK integration · up to 70% of R&D costs · max ~€350K · PARP continuous 2026 calls.
token.discountDesc: Poland directly from EU: ~€18bn through 2030 for renewables · KPO C2.1 Green Energy · combined with FEnIKS on different cost categories.

roadmap.label: Implementation schedule
roadmap.title: 27 months
roadmap.p1Desc: Preliminary LOIs (potatoes validated) · application for URE interpretation · land search 1.5–2 ha · EPC RFQs to 5 suppliers · EIC Accelerator application. Investment: ~€10–15K documentation.
roadmap.p2Desc: AInsekt Farm Sp. z o.o. incorporation (June–July 2027) · 3 binding LOIs from suppliers · land purchase · grid-connection application to OSD · environmental KIP to RDOŚ (start of DUŚ procedure).
roadmap.p3Desc: Environmental Decision (DUŚ, 6 months) · zoning permit · 2–3 binding EPC offers · FEnIKS Part 5 submission (2027 call) · WFOŚiGW · KPO C2.1 · FENG SMART (R&D).
roadmap.p4Desc: Building permit · EPC contract with CHP supplier (Jenbacher/MWM/WELTEC) · 12-month build: earthworks → foundations → fermenter tanks → CHP engine room → storage infrastructure.
roadmap.p5Desc: First MWh to grid · 15-year FIT clock starts (through 2044) · full logistics loop (2 trucks + reserve contract) · first EBITDA Q4 2029. Expansion: second 499 kW module from 2030.

legal.plDesc: 5,500 t/year · 4 logistics zones (0–120 km) · +11pp margin above 80% URE threshold for 'agricultural biogas' qualification · 3 binding LOIs in progress (planned Q3/Q4 2026).
